rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something is handled or described from general impressions rather than detailed understanding.

example.english: I described that restaurant impressionistically, without researching it in detail.
example.traditional: 我只係靠印象咁樣介紹嗰間餐廳，未有仔細研究。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zi2 hai6 kaau3 jan3 zoeng6 gam3 joeng2 gaai3 siu6 go2 gaan1 caan1 teng1 mei6 jau5 zi2 sai3 jin4 gau3

rows.note: Use this when the impressionistic approach specifically relies on intuition or a subjective feel rather than remembered impressions.

example.english: I chose this colour impressionistically, without thinking it through.
example.traditional: 我揀呢隻色純粹憑感覺，冇諗過咁多。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gaan2 ne1 zek3 sik1 seon4 seoi6 pang4 gam2 gok3 mou5 nam2 gwo3 gam3 do1
